meaning.en: (Norse mythology) A goddess, the wife of Thor.
meaning.vi: (Thần thoại Bắc Âu) Một nữ thần, vợ của thần Thor.

sentences.en: Stock Index Future is called SIF for short.

sentences.en: Conclusion SIF at a low dosage can improve the lipometabolic disturbance in rats of renal damage and reduce UPE so that it can protect renal function.

sentences.en: The SIF record format also contains delta specific columns to assist in setting the indicator values of existing database records to NULL.
